This fully heat-moldable liner adapts to your foot like a second skin, offering the perfect balance of support and responsiveness. If you’re commuting long distances or hitting up intense street sessions, the Prime liner provides cushion and performance. A secure fit comes from a triple-closure system – the sturdy Kizer Supreme buckle at the top, the Crown ratchet buckle at the ankle, and grippy waxed laces work together to keep your foot locked in place. No slipping, no distractions – just pure, controlled movement with every stride. Whichever your setup, the ride feels smooth, responsive, and perfect for urban agility. Paired with Wicked ABEC 9 chrome steel bearings, the spin is fast, fluid, and built to last. The TRINITY 3-point mounting system holds everything together, lowering the center of gravity for improved balance, smoother push-offs, and better energy transfer. It’s your edge when weaving through crowds, hitting sharp corners, or soaking up cracks in the pavement. With a mix of brown hues and sleek silhouette, the Powerslide Next 2 80 Chocolate Skates are the perfect choice for skaters seeking style, power, and precision. Whether you’re carving through alleyways or cruising down boulevards, these skates deliver buttery-smooth performance in a look that stands out from the pack. Go Chocolate. Own your ride.
